summary: Firefox added support for several web platform features, including CSS text-autospace for adjusting spacing between scripts, the Speculation Rules HTTP header for preparing likely future page loads, and Declarative Web Push. The work also improves how browser features such as color-scheme preferences, page transitions, popovers, and media loading behave, while tightening checks around data exchanged between pages and processes. Together, these changes bring Firefox closer to evolving web standards and make page behavior more consistent.
